title: plagiobothrys collinus var. californicus
intro: Plagiobothrys collinus var. californicus, commonly known as California prickly poppy or California fiddleneck, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support respiratory health and alleviate symptoms of coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Plagiobothrys collinus var. californicus are attributed to its mucilaginous properties, which can help soothe and protect mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
